entities.name: Bushrod Washington
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bushrod Washington was an American attorney and politician from the Washington family who served as Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States from 1798 to 1829. On the Supreme Court, he was a staunch ally of Chief Justice John Marshall.
